enabled.Name: Animate abilities
enabled.Hint: Play an animation and sound when a Draw Steel ability is used: a cast on the caster, a swing or projectile to each target, then an impact sized by that target's tier.

animator.Name: Animator while DS AA Bridge is active
animator.Hint: Which module animates abilities that have no animation of their own. An ability set to Custom or None on its sheet is always handled by this module. Without DS AA Bridge this module animates everything.

Choices.auto: DS AA Bridge (this module only for abilities with their own animation)

waitForDice.Name: Wait for Dice So Nice
waitForDice.Hint: Start the animation once the 3D dice of the card have settled.

volume.Name: Sound volume
volume.Hint: Volume of ability sounds (0 turns them off). Each player can also mute Sequencer sounds in Sequencer's own settings.

tierScale.Name: Impact size per tier
tierScale.Hint: Three numbers for tier 1, 2 and 3, separated by commas. A critical tier 3 (natural 19 or 20) also plays a flourish.

areaEffects.Name: Area effects
areaEffects.Hint: Play an effect over bursts, auras, cubes, walls and lines.

signatures.Name: Signature animations
signatures.Hint: Use the hand-picked animations built in for showpiece abilities (such as Power Chord, Incinerate or Unquiet Ground). An ability set to Custom or None on its sheet still uses its own.

screenShake.Name: Screen shake on big hits
screenShake.Hint: Shake the view briefly when an attack lands a tier 3 result.

hitFlash.Name: Flash on big hits
hitFlash.Hint: Flash the target's token white when an attack lands a tier 3 result.

rules.Name: Animation rules
rules.Hint: Overrides of the built-in animation rules.

debug.Name: Debug logging
debug.Hint: Log what each card resolves to in the console (F12).

Rules.MenuHint: Choose the effect files for each kind of ability and element, and which keywords set an element.
Rules.Title: Ability animation rules
Rules.Intro: Each field is a comma-separated list of Sequencer database keys or file paths; the first one available on a client plays. Leave a field empty to keep the built-in list shown in grey; enter - to drop the row so the fallback row is used.

Slot.aura: Aura or buff over the area
Slot.zone: Lasting zone (cube or wall without damage)

Rules.KeywordsHint: Used when the ability deals no typed damage.
Rules.ResetConfirm: Remove all your changes to the animation rules?
Rules.Audition: Play this row's candidates one after another, for you only, from your selected token to your first target.
Rules.AuditionNoToken: Select a token (and target another) to audition.

Item.PreviewHint: Play this animation for you only, from your selected token (or this actor's token) to your targets.
Item.BridgeFlag: This ability has its own DS AA Bridge animation, so DS AA Bridge animates it:
Item.SlotHint: Empty fields use the automatic choice shown in grey. A field takes comma-separated Sequencer database keys or file paths (the first available plays); - turns that step off.

Preview.NoSequencer: Ability animations need the Sequencer module.
Preview.NoToken: Select a token, or place this actor's token on the scene, to preview its animation.
